title: Android Developer
description: Build mobile applications for the Android OS. Master Kotlin syntax, Compose layouts, REST client caching, and local database storage.

nodes.title: Kotlin Programming
nodes.description: Master variables types, nullable values assertions, functions syntax, collections, lambdas, and class inheritances.
projectIdeas: Build a Kotlin terminal calculator app that validates mathematical operations bounds safely.
interviewQuestions: What are data classes in Kotlin?
Explain how Kotlin handles Null Safety (nullable vs non-null types).

nodes.title: Jetpack Compose Declarative UI
nodes.description: Construct layouts using composable blocks, manage view state updates, and design material layouts.
projectIdeas: Build a responsive mobile checklist app utilizing Jetpack Compose components and themes.
interviewQuestions: Explain the function of remember { mutableStateOf() } in Jetpack Compose views.

nodes.title: SQLite & Room Database Caching
nodes.description: Staging database structures, configuring entity queries, and cache API responses locally.
projectIdeas: Build a offline-first journal application caching mobile entries locally using Room database tables.
interviewQuestions: What is Room in Android and what are its key components?
Explain how DAOs map database queries to Swift/Kotlin classes.
